name: io.github.Vando-sketch/nextcloud-organizer-mcp
description: Manage Nextcloud tasks, calendar events and notes from Claude over CalDAV and the Notes API.

environmentVariables.name: NEXTCLOUD_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Nextcloud instance, e.g. https://cloud.example.com (must be https:// unless local).

environmentVariables.name: NEXTCLOUD_APP_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Nextcloud app password (Settings > Security > Devices & sessions), never the account password.

environmentVariables.name: PUBLIC_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: The exact public URL clients use to reach this server; required for the OAuth 2.1 flow.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_OAUTH_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for the OAuth consent page; required unless the server is bound and reached locally only.
